text: My paper submitted to ACM CHI 2027 advanced to the second round of review. Very excited!
Presented my paper at the CHIRA conference on self-custodial wallet usability and security in the Global South.
Done reviewing 2 CHI papers as reviewer.
Submitted a paper to ACM CHIIR 2027 on LLM privacy, security, and trust in professional settings.
My paper "Trauma-Informed Digital Safety Amidst Stigma, Surveillance and Mistrust" advanced to the second round of review at ACM CSCW.
Submitted a paper to ACM CHI 2027 titled "Understanding Satirical Mediation in the Age of AI in the Global South".
Completed reviewing 2 manuscript as a reviewer at BCCA conference.
Joined the Human Signal in Intelligence, Verification, and Empowerment (HIVE) Lab at Pennsylvania State University as a Research Intern, leading a study on age-verification technologies.
Paper on self-custodial crypto-wallet usability in Bangladesh accepted at CHIRA 2026.
Why Can't I Just Use a Username?  accepted at IEEE DAPPS 2026 (co-first author).
Paper on inclusive mobile financial services for low-literate users to appear at ACM COMPASS 2026.
Serving as a peer reviewer for ACM CHI 2027; reviewed papers for ACM COMPASS 2026 and IEEE BCCA 2026.
AuthVR published at IEEE TrustCom 2025; AR-based ATM authentication paper published in IEEE Access.
Paper on women's cybersecurity practices in Bangladesh to appear at CHIRA 2025.
Paper on birth declaration in rural last-mile Bangladesh published at ACM COMPASS 2024.
Started as a Graduate Research Assistant, Department of CSE, BRAC University, supervised by Prof. Farida Chowdhury.
Graduated with High Distinction, B.Sc. in Computer Science, BRAC University.
